children: Bitcoin holders have continued to take profits recently, but the scale has remained relatively limited, with net realized profits reaching about $5.1 billion over the past 7 days. According to ChainCatcher, this level is closer to late 2023 and is well below the profit-taking seen during previous major market tops.

title: Bitcoin Holders Realize $5.1 Billion in Net Profits Over Past 7 Days, Glassnode Data Shows
